theme: Long clause limits (extreme length clause rendering)
title: Long clause limits — paginate / full retention (IBL-B4)
description: ACTIVE IBL-B4 sample: extreme-length structured clause with LONG_CLAUSE_START / LONG_CLAUSE_END markers. Product policy is paginate + full retention (truncate rejected). Companion LongClauseOverflowGoldenCorpusTest asserts PDFBox page count >= 2 when soffice is available.
